summary: Builds a per-entry division lookup table array. For each of the (this+0x64) entries, reads the entry descriptor from the descriptor array at *(this+0x1A4)+0x20, checks whether a table slot already exists for a previously seen equal descriptor, and otherwise allocates a 1024-byte table through the allocator vtable at this+0x4, filling it with (65025 - 510 * byte) / ((descriptor << 9) - 512) results for every source pair in the global table dbl_5B05C8 up to dword_5B06C8. Called by CodecModeSelect (0x0051EA90).

operations.description: Entry count guard: when *(this + 0x64) > 0 proceed with per-entry table construction; otherwise return immediately with no tables built.
Load the context pointer v1 = *(this + 0x1A4); it carries the entry-descriptor array (at +0x20) and the per-entry table-slot storage (at +0x34).
Outer do-while loop over entry index v15 from 0 up to *(this + 0x64), one iteration per entry descriptor.
Read the entry descriptor v3 = *(*(this + 0x1A4) + 0x20 + 4*v15) from the descriptor array field *(this+0x1A4)+0x20.
Uniqueness scan: walk the already-seen descriptors starting at *(this + 0x1A4) + 0x20 while v3 != descriptor, bounded by v15; a match yields the index of the previously built table.
Reuse guard: when a non-zero table pointer already exists for the matched index (*(context + 0x34 + 4*v4) != 0), skip allocation and reuse the existing table.
Allocate a 1024-byte table through the allocator vtable: v12 = (**(this + 0x4))(this, 1, 1024), where *(this+0x4) is the allocator object and *(*(this+0x4))+0x0 is its allocate entry.
Compute the scaled divisor v7 = (v3 << 9) - 512 from the entry descriptor; the division result set depends on this value.
Outer fill loop: walk the double source table from dbl_5B05C8 (start) up to dword_5B06C8 (end), advancing 16 bytes (two doubles) per pass.
Inner fill loop: for i in 0..15 compute v10 = (65025 - 510 * byte(source + i)) / v7 and store each result consecutively in the newly allocated table.
Store the table pointer into the per-entry slot at context + 0x34 + 4*v15, advance v15, and continue until all *(this + 0x64) entries are processed.
Invoked by CodecModeSelect (0x0051EA90) as part of codec/mode setup, supplying the context whose +0x64 entries get division tables.
